subject: reasoning
question: Sunil starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 4 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Sunil starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the south.

He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 4 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/feebd6f525da31550069737bf561ec9087fe4db2f6dc96d56f1c9eeccd09b7fc.png] 

Thus, 9 km to the east he should drive in order to reach Point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
